texts.text: Then,<pause>out from the trees,<pause>there it was.<pause>Home.<pause>
Voices called out.<pause>Feet hurried down the path.<pause>
Arms wrapped tight.<pause>Happy tears fell.<pause>The little one was safe.<pause>The dog had brought him home.<pause>
That evening,<pause>the house glowed warm.<pause>The long day softened.<pause>The woods felt far away.<pause>
A loyal nose.<pause>A brave heart.<pause>Home at last.
